messages:
mina (Design): dropping a small design question about the Keys panel: when users rotate a key should we 1) keep them in the modal so they can copy the secret, or 2) close the modal and show a toast with a link to view the new key? quick takes please

ajay (Eng): keeping modal open is simplest and avoids clipboard races. we can auto-select the secret field but won't auto-copy. closing + toast is fine too but SR users lose context unless we mirror the secret somewhere persistent.

luca (PM): product prefers modal-for-copy. many users immediately paste the secret into deployments. closing to list is faster for multi-key flows but more error prone. compromise: keep modal open, add a focused "Done, go to keys" button that closes when pressed.

tess (A11y): agree with keep-in-modal. make sure the revealed secret region has aria-live=\"assertive\" and focus lands in the input. do NOT auto-copy. label the copy button "Copy secret (only shown once)" and announce success with a polite live region. also the revoke warning needs clearer consequences: replace "irreversible" with "This will immediately stop any services using this key."

mina (Design): updated microcopy proposal: header: "New API key" body: "This secret is shown only once. Copy it now and store it safely." revoke text: "Revoking this key will immediately stop any services using it and cannot be undone." added a small info icon next to Role with one-line tooltip.

ajay (Eng): implementation notes: tooltip = info button, keyboard focusable. we'll set aria-describedby on role dropdown to the tooltip content when visible. for the secret region we'll add aria-atomic and assertive live to ensure SRs hear it on reveal.

luca (PM): also add a lightweight guardrail when someone picks Admin: show inline yellow banner "Admin can manage apps and rotate keys 	6 proceed with caution" with a checkbox only for first-time admins in the org. track analytics for copy vs download.

tess (A11y): checkbox must be reachable and its state obvious to SRs. banner text not rely on color; include an icon + text. we'll run a short pairing when the PR lands to validate focus order and live region announcements.

mina (Design): thanks all 60a I'll push the updated mock + copy PR and attach a short video of the new focus order. bot-ci: please run tests on branch feature/keys-compact-rotate

bot-ci: pipeline passed for branch feature/keys-compact-rotate (build 2031-07-21T10:02Z)

luca (PM): great, scheduling a 15-min check after PR lands.
